recap: Created mark-list-raw autoloaded function and mark.zsh alias file with MARKPATH export and aliases
Created mark-jump autoloaded function that resolves project or mark names to directories via cd
Rewrote complete-jumps to merge marks and projects with project-wins-on-collision, updated _jumps compdef to serve only j/mark-jump
Created mark-create autoloaded function with dirname default, overwrite, project-match warning, and MARKPATH auto-creation
Created mark-delete, complete-marks, and _marks compdef for marks-only deletion with tab completion
Created mark-list autoloaded function with colorized table output via mark-list-raw
Deleted old mark/unmark scripts and jump.zsh aliases, added j alias to _jumps compdef registration
Created mark-cleanup-redundant to identify and interactively remove marks duplicating project paths
